title: 第四章  找林澈的？
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“你这个小兔崽子！”

“快说到底发生了什么事！”

林澈把事情从头到尾说了一遍....

怎么被陷害的，怎么被打的，丫鬟怎么死的，公主怎么趁机提和离的。

他尽量说得客观冷静，不带任何情绪。

可林龙虎听完之后，非但没有同情他，反而一巴掌抽了过来。

“啪！”

清脆响亮，打得林澈半边脸都麻了。

林澈捂着脸，整个人都懵了。

自己被人陷害，差点丢了性命，老爹非但不帮自己出气，反而先赏了一巴掌？

这什么逻辑？

他上辈子是刨了林家的祖坟吗？

“你惹谁不好，偏偏去惹孙丞相的儿子！”

林龙虎的唾沫星子喷了林澈一脸：

“你还答应了和离？”

“你脑子被驴踢了？”

林澈还没来得及解释，一跟长棍就呼啸而来。

他猛地一闪，长棍落地。

溅起一片尘土！

“我要打死你这个闯祸的混蛋！”

林龙虎见林澈居然敢躲，怒气更甚。

林澈见状猛的一把拽住长棍！

“够了！”

这一嗓子把林龙虎吼愣住了。

在林龙虎的印象里，这个儿子从来不敢跟他顶嘴，更别说吼他了。

每次被挨打都是乖乖伸出屁股，连屁都不敢放一个。

“不是我闯祸！”

林澈瞪着通红的眼睛：

“是有人处心积虑要害死你儿子！”

“你看不清局面吗？”

“我回来是想问你，咱家是否反击！”

“还是忍气吞声，受着？”

林龙虎被吼得愣了三秒钟，然后脸涨得更红了，青筋暴起：

“你敢吼我？”

“你眼里还有没有我这个老子？”

“反击？”

“要不是你惹到他们，怎么会有这么大的祸端？”

“还要反击，你是看我们林家舒服日子过久了，想要毁了林家？”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"You little brat!"

"Tell me what happened!"

Lin Che told the story from beginning to end...

How was she framed, how was she beaten, how did the maid die, and how did the princess take the opportunity to make peace with her.

He tried to speak objectively and calmly, without any emotion.

But after Lin Longhu heard this, instead of sympathizing with him, he slapped him.

"Crack!"

It was so clear and loud that half of Lin Che's face was numb.

Lin Che covered her face and was completely confused.

He was framed and almost lost his life. Instead of helping him to vent his anger, his father gave him a slap in the face first?

What kind of logic is this?

Did he dig up the Lin family's ancestral graves in his previous life?

"It's not good for you to offend anyone, but you offend Prime Minister Sun's son!"

Lin Longhu sprayed Lin Che's face with spit:

"You still agreed to peace?"

"Have you been kicked in the head by a donkey?"

Before Lin Che had time to explain, a long stick came roaring towards her.

He dodged suddenly and the long stick fell to the ground.

A splash of dust!

"I'm going to beat you to death, you bastard who caused trouble!"

Lin Longhu became even more angry when he saw that Lin Che dared to hide.

Lin Che saw this and grabbed the long stick fiercely!

"Enough!"

This voice stunned Lin Longhuhou.

In Lin Longhu's impression, this son never dared to talk back to him, let alone yell at him.

Every time I was spanked, I would stick out my butt obediently, not even daring to fart.

"It wasn't me who caused the trouble!"

Lin Che stared with red eyes:

"Someone is deliberately trying to kill your son!"

"Can't you see the situation clearly?"

"I came back to ask you if our family will fight back!"

"Or should I swallow my anger and suffer?"

Lin Longhu was stunned for three seconds by the roar, and then his face turned redder and his veins popped out:

"You dare to yell at me?"

"Do you still see me as an old man in your eyes?"

"Fight back?"

"If you hadn't offended them, how could there have been such a big trouble?"

"You still want to fight back. Do you think our Lin family has been living comfortably for too long and you want to destroy the Lin family?"
